name: How do I choose the right real estate agent to price and sell my luxury condo?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right real estate agent to price and sell my luxury condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting the right real estate agent for your luxury condo involves finding someone with a proven track record in high-end properties within your specific market, such as Boca Raton or Las Olas. Look for an agent with deep local expertise, strong negotiation skills, and a comprehensive marketing strategy tailored for luxury listings. They should be able to provide a detailed Comparative Market Analysis, demonstrate a clear understanding of your property's unique value propositions, and have a network of affluent buyers. Kelby Contreras and Realty ONE Group Evolution specialize in these areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an agent with proven experience in your luxury market, deep local expertise, strong negotiation skills, and a tailored marketing strategy for high-end properties.
